model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the proportion of veterans within the overall US population over time. The x-axis is labeled "Year", uses a linear scale, ranges from 1960 to 2010, and has tick labels at 10-year intervals. The y-axis is a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 15, and is labeled with a percentage symbol, indicating units of percentage. A single red line with circular markers is plotted on the graph. Starting at the value of 12.8 at the year 1960, the line decreases to 11.0 at the year 1980, then continues to decrease to a value of 7 at the year 2010.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the proportion of veterans within the total population over time. The x-axis is labeled "Year" and has a linear scale ranging from 1960 to 2010, with tick labels placed every 10 years. The y-axis is labeled with percentage values, ranging from 0 to 15% with a linear scale and tick labels placed every 5%. A single red line with circular markers represents the data. At the start of the x-axis in 1960, the line begins at 12.8%. In 1970 it is at 13.8%. In 1980, the line shows a value of 12.1%. By 1990 the line is at 11.0%, followed by 9.4% in 2000, and finally, 7% in 2010.
